supports: Brought to life by Germán Sitz and Pedro Peña, Niño Gordo exploded onto the Buenos Aires dining scene as a genre-defying Asian grill with Argentine soul, earning a spot at #21 on Latin America's 50 Best.
Now in Miami, Niño Gordo brings that same spirit to Wynwood, fusing Japanese, Korean, and Southeast Asian techniques.
Tucked behind a vintage cigarette machine, Dekotora is Niño Gordo's craft cocktail bar, inspired by Japan's tricked-out trucks.
Niño Gordo Miami is at 112 NW 28th St, Miami, FL 33127.
Opening hours are Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday from 6:30 PM to 10 PM and Friday and Saturday from 6:30 PM to 11 PM.
